title: 第9章 案发第10章 案子破了凶手就是
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
肌肉酸痛和生物钟准时叫醒冯睦。
每天睁眼，首先映入视网膜的必然是系统界面。
[游戏继承进度1%。]
[奖励已发送！]
[请玩家再接再厉，努力提升进度，解锁继承更多奖励…..]
冯睦关闭界面，撇撇嘴：“系统才是要再接再厉，早点把奖励送达啊，已发送和已签收是两码事儿，懂不懂啊。”
冯睦觉得自己每天一睁眼就查询界面，像极是前世网购后，等待物流上门，心情那叫一个刺挠，急死个人。
唯有食铁能消减这种急切。
在卫生间简单洗漱一番，冯睦才反应过来，自己已经两天没有宠信马桶了。
“因为只吃铁不吃饭，所以不用排泄，很合理，我虽然依旧顶着人类的皮囊，但内在正在脱离血肉凡胎啊。”
冯睦看着镜子里的脸孔，比往日少了点血色，皮肤都变白了一点。
扯开衣领，把胸口照在镜子上，不知道是不是心理作用，他觉得胸口的肌肉似乎内凹了一厘米，隐约勾勒一点骨头的棱角。
冯睦用手抵住皮肤，那股从骨头里透出的凉意更明显了，就像是皮肉里藏了冰冷的铁块。
“骨头在铁化？唔，不会最后会长出皮肉吧。”
冯睦咽了口唾沫，脑海不禁回想起上辈子看过的某个动漫人物，那家伙就是可以把骨头从身体里抽出来起舞，牛逼的一塌糊涂。
他最后的下场是啥来着，骨癌还是血液病？
吞咽掉几颗铁珠，冯睦将这个疑问抛之脑后，背上书包出门而去。
今天没有去五金店，而是径直去学校，在路过一处破桥洞时，冯睦停下自行车，把食盒扔了过去。
破桥洞下搭了个棚子，里面住着几个乞儿，脸上黑糊糊的看不出性别，目光空洞麻木。
直到一条野狗把食盒刨开，乞儿们才宛若被突然激活，嘴里同时发出低沉的嘶吼，手足并用的扑向野狗。

那瞬间，冯睦差点分不清那混为一团中，哪个是人哪个是狗。
他骑着自行车离开。
大清早的，学校门口就停了辆警车，两个巡捕房的捕头跟着门卫走进校园，路过的学生和老师都用好奇的目光瞅过去。
冯睦推着车子，刻意放缓步行，耳朵里依稀听到“失踪”、“调查”等字眼。
冯睦眯眼，不经意间用余光把两个捕头的样貌记下。
校园生活是重复且单调的，忽然进来两个捕头，就像是在清淡的汤水里扔进两颗猫屎，想不吸睛都难。
冯睦安静的坐在教室后排，哪都不用去，也不用打听，零零碎碎的消息就会汇总入他的耳朵里。
“我跟你讲，那俩捕头是来……”
“哦，巡捕房接到了两起报案，分别是……”
“我从高二四班打听了，是这样的…..”
“.……”
每一个班级都化作情报基站，学生们集体变身为情报特务，最可怕的是，压根儿没有保密意识。
他们乐此不疲的分享情报，交换信息，最后，又无孔不入的把最新消息传遍学校的每个角落。
而这，正是冯睦处理完尸体后，依旧死赖在学校的原因，他等的就是这一刻。
“所有人都是我的耳目，谢谢。”
冯睦眼眶微湿，他感受到了来自同学的情谊与帮助，脑海快速转动，整理出初步情报：
女死者，王薇，高二四班，长相姣好，性格内向，成绩普通，家境贫穷，父亲早亡，母亲是个空白民，最近好像家里出事了，很缺钱。
男死者，郑航，高二七班，长相一般，成绩中等，但出手阔绰，在校内有几个跟班儿，高中已经换了三四个女朋友了，听说家里有点背景。
郑航高一追过王薇，王薇没答应。
王薇母亲前天晚上报案，郑航父亲昨天报案。

…….
content_en:
Muscle soreness and the biological clock woke Feng Mu up on time.
When you open your eyes every day, the first thing that hits your retina is the system interface.
[The game inherits 1% of the progress. ]
[Reward has been sent! ]
[Players are requested to keep up their efforts, work hard to improve progress, and unlock and inherit more rewards...]
Feng Mu closed the interface and curled his lips: "The system needs to keep up its efforts and deliver the rewards as soon as possible. Sent and signed for are two different things. Do you understand?"
Feng Mu felt that he checked the interface every day as soon as he opened his eyes. It was like waiting for the logistics to arrive after online shopping in his previous life.
Only eating iron can reduce this urgency.
After a brief wash in the bathroom, Feng Mu realized that he had not trusted the toilet for two days.
"Because I only eat iron without food, I don't need to excrete it. It makes sense. Although I still carry a human skin, my inner body is leaving the flesh and blood body."
Feng Mu looked at his face in the mirror. His face was a little less bloody than before, and his skin was a little whiter.
He pulled open his collar and looked at his chest in the mirror. He didn't know if it was a psychological effect, but he felt that the muscles in his chest seemed to be concave by a centimeter, vaguely outlining the edges of the bones.
Feng Mu put his hand against his skin, and the coolness coming from his bones became more obvious, as if there was cold iron hidden in his skin.
"The bones are turning into iron? Well, they won't eventually grow skin and flesh, right?"
Feng Mu swallowed, and his mind couldn't help but recall a certain anime character he had seen in his previous life. That guy could pull bones out of his body and dance. He was so awesome.
What will be his final fate, bone cancer or blood disease?
After swallowing a few iron beads, Feng Mu put the question behind him, put on his schoolbag and went out.
Instead of going to the hardware store today, he went straight to school. When passing by a broken bridge, Feng Mu stopped his bicycle and threw the food box over.
A shed was built under the broken bridge, and a few beggars lived in it. Their faces were so dark that their gender could not be identified, and their eyes were hollow and numb.
It wasn't until a wild dog dug open the food box that the beggars seemed to be suddenly activated. They let out low roars at the same time and pounced on the wild dog with hands and feet.
At that moment, Feng Mu almost couldn't tell which one was a human and which one was a dog in the mixed group.
He left on his bicycle.
Early in the morning, a police car parked in front of the school. Two police officers followed the guards into the campus. The students and teachers passing by looked at it with curiosity.
Feng Mu pushed the car and deliberately walked slowly, vaguely hearing words such as "missing" and "investigation" in his ears.
Feng Mu squinted his eyes and inadvertently took note of the appearance of the two arresters with his peripheral vision.
Campus life is repetitive and monotonous. Suddenly, two catchers come in, like throwing two cat poop into the light soup. It is difficult not to attract attention.
Feng Mu sat quietly in the back row of the classroom. He didn't need to go anywhere or ask, all the bits and pieces of news would fall into his ears.
"I'm telling you, those two arresters are here..."
"Oh, the patrol room received two reports, namely..."
"I asked about it from Class 4, Grade 2, and it's like this..."
"......."
Every class has been turned into an intelligence base station, and the students have collectively transformed into intelligence agents. The most frightening thing is that they have no sense of confidentiality at all.
They happily shared intelligence and exchanged information, and finally spread the latest news to every corner of the school.
And this was the reason why Feng Mu still stayed in school after disposing of the body. He had been waiting for this moment.
"Everyone is my eyes and ears, thank you."
Feng Mu's eyes were slightly moist. He felt the friendship and help from his classmates. His mind turned quickly and he sorted out the preliminary information:
The female deceased, Wang Wei, was in Class 4, Grade 2. She was good-looking, introverted, with average grades. Her family was poor, her father died young, and her mother was a homeless person. It seemed like something had happened at home recently, and it was very difficult.Short of money.
The deceased male, Zheng Hang, was in Class 7, Grade 2. He had an average appearance and average grades, but he spent a lot of money. He had several followers in school and had three or four girlfriends in high school. I heard that his family had some background.
Zheng Hang chased Wang Wei in his first year of high school, but Wang Wei didn't agree.
Wang Wei's mother reported the case the night before yesterday, and Zheng Hang's father reported the case yesterday.
….
